nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether minting is open; read in mintCheeks and written by startMint/pauseMint.
Internal pseudo-random seed mutated by random(); derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
Internal mint price (0.01 ether) returned by calculatePrice and used in the mint payment check.
Array of Cheek structs; pushed to during mint and its length feeds the randomness seed.
Freeze flag guarding setBaseURI and set by freezeBaseURI.
Base token URI string set via setBaseURI and consumed by _baseURI/tokenURI.
Public payable mint entry point; loops numCheeks times, generates traits via random() and safe-mints to msg.sender.
Internal randomness generator using block.difficulty, block.timestamp and mutable seed state.
OnlyOwner function that sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender using low-level send.
OnlyOwner setter for _baseTokenURI guarded by isBaseURIFrozen.
OnlyOwner function that permanently sets isBaseURIFrozen to true.
OnlyOwner function enabling minting by setting hasMintStarted = true.
OnlyOwner function disabling minting by setting hasMintStarted = false.
Public view returning the stored price state variable.
Public view concatenating _baseTokenURI with the token id.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient and as withdrawal destination.
Miner-influenceable timestamp mixed into the random seed generation.
Low-level ETH transfer payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance) in withdrawAll, executes before any state finalization.
_safeMint invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving control to external code mid-loop.
Randomness derived from block.timestamp/block.difficulty/cheeks.length, predictable and miner-influenceable.
User-supplied number of tokens to mint, bounded to 1..20.
Local token id computed as totalSupply() during the mint loop.
Local string holding the randomly selected tattoo trait name.
Owner-supplied base URI argument of setBaseURI.
Loop counter in mintCheeks.

edges.reason: mintCheeks reads hasMintStarted to enforce that minting has started.
mintCheeks reads price indirectly through calculatePrice for the msg.value check.
mintCheeks pushes new Cheek structs into the cheeks array and reads its length.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside the mint loop.
mintCheeks calls random() multiple times per iteration to pick traits.
random() mixes block.timestamp into the seed, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is the insecure entropy source for the pseudo-random generation.
mintCheeks relies on timestamp-derived randomness for trait and rarity generation.
random() writes the newly computed value into the seed state variable.
The timestamp-based unsafe randomness result mutates the persistent seed.
_safeMint inside the mint loop calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract, re-entering external code.
mintCheeks computes mintIndex = totalSupply() for each newly minted token.
mintCheeks reads and validates the numCheeks parameter.
mintCheeks assigns the randomly selected tattoo trait to the local tattoo variable.
mintCheeks uses the loop counter i to bound the minting iteration.
mintCheeks invokes calculatePrice() to determine the required payment.
calculatePrice returns the price state variable.
setBaseURI writes the owner-supplied URI into _baseTokenURI.
setBaseURI reads isBaseURIFrozen to ensure the URI is not frozen.
setBaseURI consumes the baseURI parameter.
freezeBaseURI sets isBaseURIFrozen to true.
startMint sets hasMintStarted to true.
pauseMint sets hasMintStarted to false.
withdrawAll sends the contract balance to msg.sender.
withdrawAll performs an external send of the full balance to a caller-controlled address, allowing reentrancy before completion.
The untrusted msg.sender is the recipient of the unsafe low-level send.
tokenURI reads _baseTokenURI to build the token metadata URI.
mintCheeks indirectly reads _baseTokenURI during safe minting via tokenURI resolution.

normalization_plan.reason: numCheeks is an external parameter used exclusively to bound and drive the mintCheeks loop.
mintIndex is a transient local derived from totalSupply() and passed to _safeMint within mintCheeks.
tattoo is a loop-local trait string consumed only inside the mintCheeks iteration body.
baseURI is an owner-supplied parameter used solely to update _baseTokenURI in setBaseURI.
i is the loop counter local scoped entirely to the mintCheeks iteration.
